assumptions.hpUse: Magnum one-shot conversion only; all other targets are immortal damage meters
assumptions.distanceDefinition: free gap from player skin to nearest body surface; first ray hit is distance + playerRadius
assumptions.packing: square lattice, random rotation and phase, one aimed first body, local overlaps removed
assumptions.targetsPerShotDefinition: unique bodies hit per trigger; pellet intersections separately reported
assumptions.burn: one shared non-stacking burn, periodic union of live intervals including reload
assumptions.cycle: R immediately after final shot: (magazine-1)*interval + max(reloadTime,interval) + minigun spin-up; melee windup is inside its duration
assumptions.environment: open flat ground, no walls, cover, recoil, pushback, armour, enemies moving, deaths or player danger
assumptions.convergence: infinite periodic field truncated only outside maximum range + blast radius + body half diagonal
assumptions.limitations: raw throughput is neither kills/s nor survivability; no overkill deduction, tactical sweep, frame/network latency, stock or pickup scarcity
